sections.title: The experience behind CreativaLabs.io.
sections.text: More than twenty-five years building, scaling and transforming engineering organizations in consulting, digital product and nearshore services, across Latin America and the United States.
sections.bio:
Builder and architect of large-scale enterprise solutions, SDLC expert and certified coach in engineering leadership.
Author of The Second Industrialization of Software, the TELAR method and the SPIRAL method for building MVPs rapidly with AI.

timeline.title: Track record
timeline.subtitle: From the software factory to engineering with AI agents.

items.text: Spec-driven development and AI agents on an insurance platform.
50 engineers on cloud-native solutions; first adoption of AI assistants.
Neobank for young people’s financial inclusion; event-driven microservices architecture and a pre-seed round of about USD 1 million.
More than 70 engineers; built the product development area.
Multi-tenant B2B SaaS platform with e-commerce, payments and a marketplace.
240-person organization across four product lines; agile transformation.
30-person nearshore teams for Disney Parks and TripAdvisor.

Methodology governance platform built on the SPEM and UMA standards: processes as reusable assets and model-driven development (MDD/MDA). A 65-person organization. Fifteen years before agents, the same idea that underpins TELAR today: intent and process govern construction.
Software factory grown from 6 to more than 200 engineers; about USD 12 million in deals.
Architecture of personal, business and branch banking for Banco Santander.
